title: How is Hitler connected to Pikachu?
description: A former king, Churchill, the Queen and King Charles connect Adolf Hitler to Pikachu.
hook: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Pikachu?

image.file: File:Duc et duchesse de Windsor avec Hitler (1937).jpg

links.line: In 1937, a year after giving up the British throne, Edward the Eighth visited Hitler.

image.file: File:Churchill with Duke of Windsor in 1948.jpg

links.line: In 1948, the former king strolled the French Riviera with his old friend Winston Churchill.
On Victory in Europe Day, 1945, Churchill stood on the palace balcony beside young Princess Elizabeth.

image.file: File:Royal Family Platinum Jubilee Balcony Appearance 2022.jpg

links.line: In 2022, the Queen stood on that same balcony beside her son Charles.
Months later, Ryan Reynolds showed King Charles around his Welsh football club.

pair.credit: Legendary Pictures / Warner Bros. (via IMP Awards)

links.line: And Reynolds was the voice of Pikachu in the movie Detective Pikachu.
